prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, 9-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman in girl-crush makeup — fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, long sleek black hair, a cold, commanding gaze. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big black-steel hoop and a thick bar.

Physique: Her waist cinched to an impossible minimum, making the contrast with the enormous rear utterly extreme: the rear and hips flare to more than four times the width of that narrow waist, an enormous rounded rear projecting far out behind her and merging into the lower back and thighs as one continuous mass, a moderate chest, slim shoulders, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stub-stubs in 9 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stub-stubs (excluding arms): 9 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): solid transparent soft pink rose quartz. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): solid transparent milky moonstone. Band 3 (torso/hip band 3): solid transparent milky precious opal. Band 4 (torso/hip band 4): solid transparent orange-red carnelian. Band 5 (torso/hip band 5): carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque. Band 6 (torso/hip band 6): carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque. Band 7 (torso/hip band 7): carved solid deep grey labradorite that flashes blue-green light, completely opaque. Band 8 (torso/hip band 8): carved solid bright blue-green amazonite streaked with white feldspar, completely opaque. Band 9 (both thigh-stub-stubs, just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate): carved solid banded black and white onyx, completely opaque, rounding off at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep royal blue on one side and a warm golden orange on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so blue light glances off one side and orange light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
